changes: I have been laid off from my job, so if you happen to have a manager who plays warhammer please send them this site :)
Continued to enhance the test case coverage. Now up to 409 cases with ~70% code coverage
Removed the range column from the weapons table in the Fight phase
Removed the range +/" for weapons without ranges (torrent weapons)
Fixed an issue with the scroll to top button
Fixed an issue with escape keys not closing modals
Fixed about 20ish name matching errors
Did another data pull, should have the new Guard models now
Continued to enhance the test case coverage
Added an option to omit weapons filtering. Use this option if you have weapons that aren't showing up.
Added a panic button if the page fails to render
Enabled site persistance, which should prevent list from needing repaste on incidental refresh
Fixed Agents Faction bug
Fixed a Firing Deck bug
Pulled down the updated Aeldari and Guard codices
Likely introduced some name bugs with the new pull down of the data. If you notice a unit missing, please report it.
Waha updated how keyword tags are sent over, I will be introducing a method to handle this shortly.
Added a new setting option, card grouping. This collapses identical cards into a single card with a number in the name
Added a 3 column breakpoint for wider screens, should make this look better on desktop
Fixed an issue with Pactbound Zealots detachment not matching up
Fixed an issue with Aeldari not counting as Eldar in the faction matcher
Fixed issues with stratagems being entirely filtered out
Fixed an issue where the Space Marines needed to be called Adeptus Astartes
Fixed some typescript errors on the phase tables
Fixes for the weapon set 'Psychic Gifts'. Please report missing weapons in discord! It's usually a mapping error.
Fix for the double tap card collapsing on mobile.
Greatly improved site performance by caching all unit data on paste submission
Fixed the stratagems panel on desktop
(I believe) Fixed the issue where tapping to scroll the screen would cause the cards to collapse.
Added support for equipped Detachment Enhancements
I decided I wanted this app to actually look good, so I found a UI design handbook and refactored the entire UI. This release includes beta bugfixes (join the Discord!).
Split the UI into a Light Mode and a Dark Mode. Dark mode is the default. Please let me know if you have problems with visibility! I am not color blind and do care about accessibility.
Combined the army/detachment header with the Army Rule Button to save screen space
Adjusted the changelog button to make it clearer what that is
Improved the layout of the army rule panel on XS screens (phones in portrait mode)
Made adjustments to the modal display to unify their design
Finally fixed the 'Copy Sample' button for iOS. I actually intend to do a blog post about this because it screwed me up for a while.
Tweaks to the appearance of the changelog
Added Sort Options to the settings menu. This allows you to select between alphabetical order and the order your list was pasted in from NewRecruit.
Added support for datasheet keywords. Added a setting to disable them if you don't want to see them.
Added support for the following CORE abilities: Fights First, Infiltrators, Scout, Deadly Demise, Firing Deck, Lone Op, Stealth, and more.
Added a toggle button that collapses the cards after they are clicked. Added a setting to disable this feature if you don't want it.
Fixed some detachment rules displaying for the wrong factions
Improved table displays that bleed off the edge of the card
Fixed a bug where variations in the Detachment selection line could cause detachments to not be detected properly.
Added Leadership saves to the Saves cards to account for battleshock tests forced by enemies
Stratagems: Now supported in a flyout menu! They are filtered by phase and detachment. Please report any errors in the discord.
Fixed more spelling errors. Abilities should be ready for feedback on which phases they show up in.
Further improved the mobile and tablet layouts to better support touch devices.
Fixed more spelling errors
Fixed a bug where abilities without text would be displayed
Fixed a bug that caused certain weapons to get excluded
Added support for the Army and Detachment Rules
Fixed more spelling errors
Fixed (what should be) the last of the allied faction bugs
Fixed spelling errors for the Norn Assimilator
Made cards not grayed out if the have an available ability in that phase

Ability Support: Abilities on datasheet cards are now displayed in the relevant phase. This includes abilities that are not tied to a specific phase. This was a pretty massive undertaking and there are almost certainly cards in the wrong phase. Please let me know if you see any issues. The game has over 3500 abilities and I have to programatically assign them to phases.
Please join the discord to offer feedback and report issues! Link at the bottom of the Changelog.
Further worked to improve the look of the mobile layout
Added Toughness to the Saves cards
Fixed more allied faction bugs
Fixed a slew of bugs related to missing Keyword Tags

Added support for allied units in factions. This is something that I have to manually update, so please let me know if you see any issues or missing units. I tried to make tester list with every faction but I am not sure on all of the ally rules.
The copy to clipboard sample actually works now
Cards are now pre-toggled if there is not any information available for them during that phase (ie, no guns during the shooting phase)
Adds a settings modal with the ability to filter out phases you don't need (World Eaters don't need a Shooting Phase)
Improved the look of the mobile layout
Fixed a slew of bugs related to missing Keyword Tags
Added support for Saves
Initial release
Supports own player phases, with limited support for the Charge phase
